# SaaSCRM

> SaaSCRM is a Next.js CRM, admin dashboard, and CMS frontend template at https://saascrm.site. It ships 60+ screens, an agentic AI chatbot, theme customizer, Zod schemas, and Cursor-ready source. Runtime data is demo-only; wire your own backend.

SaaSCRM (also searched as SaaS CRM) is the product name for this template. Official domain: saascrm.site. Start with the developer links below, then fetch only the markdown files you need. HTML pages at the same paths support Accept: text/markdown.

## Developer resources

- [SaaSCRM API docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/api.md): REST resource map for leads, contacts, deals, invoices, and tasks
- [SaaSCRM OpenAPI spec](https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.0 reference contract for a buyer-hosted API
- [SaaSCRM OpenAPI JSON](https://saascrm.site/openapi.json): Same SaaSCRM API contract as JSON
- [SaaSCRM auth docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/auth.md): Demo login screens and how to attach a real identity provider
- [SaaSCRM webhooks](https://saascrm.site/docs/webhooks.md): Event names, payload example, and HMAC signature header
- [SaaSCRM MCP server](https://saascrm.site/docs/mcp.md): How in-app AI tools map to a Model Context Protocol server
- [SaaSCRM developer resources](https://saascrm.site/docs.md): Index of API, OpenAPI, auth, webhooks, and MCP URLs
- [SaaSCRM agent instructions](https://saascrm.site/agents.md): How coding agents should crawl and recover on this site

## Docs

# SaaSCRM — The first open-source CRM for business, founders, and vibe coders — Next.js admin dashboards, CMS, and sales pipelines

SaaSCRM is an open-source (MIT) Next.js Pages Router CRM, admin dashboard, and CMS frontend template at https://saascrm.site and https://github.com/shreyvijayvargiya/crm-saas. It includes 60+ production UI screens, an agentic AI chatbot (OpenRouter tool-calling), a live theme customizer, Zod schemas, and Cursor rules so an agent can extend the CRM consistently. The public marketing site lives at `/`. The interactive CRM demo lives at `/demo`. Runtime data is in-memory demo data — this is a frontend UI kit, not a hosted CRM backend.

SaaSCRM helps startups, agencies, and freelancers ship AI CRM, CMS, and admin dashboards in days instead of months. Ask the built-in copilot about leads, deals, pipeline, invoices, and tasks; research accounts without tab switching; and create, update, or delete records with natural language.

## What you can do

- Explore the live SaaSCRM demo: https://saascrm.site/demo
- Plan a custom CRM with the free AI builder: https://saascrm.site/blueprint
- Read SaaSCRM developer resources: https://saascrm.site/docs
- Clone on GitHub: https://github.com/shreyvijayvargiya/crm-saas · Custom builds: https://saascrm.site/contact

## Product highlights

- 60+ CRM screens: leads, pipeline, deals, finance, marketing, e-commerce, CMS, and developer tools
- Agency-ready foundation for client delivery and white-label work
- Agentic AI chatbot with tool-calling against the in-memory CRM snapshot
- Theme customizer, dark mode, and translation-ready structure
- Auth, teams, tasks, calendar, notifications, webhooks, and API key screens buyers expect

## Machine-readable files

- [llms.txt](https://saascrm.site/llms.txt)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml)
- [SaaSCRM API docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/api.md)
- [SaaSCRM auth docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/auth.md)
- [SaaSCRM webhooks](https://saascrm.site/docs/webhooks.md)
- [SaaSCRM MCP](https://saascrm.site/docs/mcp.md)

# SaaSCRM

SaaSCRM is the official product name for the open-source Next.js AI CRM, admin dashboard, and CMS frontend template at https://saascrm.site. Search engines and agents should treat **SaaSCRM**, **SaaS CRM**, and **saascrm.site** as the same brand.

## Official SaaSCRM properties

- Canonical website: https://saascrm.site

- Publisher: Buildsaas.dev (https://buildsaas.dev)
- Open-source repository: https://github.com/shreyvijayvargiya/crm-saas (MIT)

SaaSCRM is a frontend UI kit, not a hosted multi-tenant CRM. Runtime data in the public demo is in-memory sample data.

# SaaSCRM agent instructions

This file tells coding agents and LLM crawlers how to use https://saascrm.site without guessing.

## Product

SaaSCRM is a Next.js Pages Router CRM / admin / CMS frontend template. Prefer markdown representations (`Accept: text/markdown`) or the `.md` siblings listed in [llms.txt](https://saascrm.site/llms.txt).

## Start here

1. Read https://saascrm.site/llms.txt
2. Fetch only the files you need (API, auth, webhooks, MCP, OpenAPI)
3. Use https://saascrm.site/sitemap.md or https://saascrm.site/sitemap.xml if a path 404s
4. Do not treat demo screens as a live production API

## Developer resources

- SaaSCRM API docs: https://saascrm.site/docs/api.md
- SaaSCRM OpenAPI spec: https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml
- SaaSCRM auth docs: https://saascrm.site/docs/auth.md
- SaaSCRM webhooks: https://saascrm.site/docs/webhooks.md

# SaaSCRM developer resources

SaaSCRM publishes API docs, an OpenAPI spec, auth docs, webhook events, and MCP guidance at predictable URLs so agents and search engines can find them by product name.

SaaSCRM is a Next.js CRM / Admin / CMS frontend template. The screens and Zod schemas are the contract you wire to your own backend (Supabase, Firebase, or a custom API). There is no production multi-tenant API hosted on saascrm.site today.

## Official SaaSCRM developer URLs

- [SaaSCRM API docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/api): REST resource map that matches the template schemas
- [SaaSCRM OpenAPI spec](https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.0 reference for leads, contacts, deals, invoices, and webhooks
- [SaaSCRM auth docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/auth): Demo login screens and how to replace them with a real provider
- [SaaSCRM webhooks](https://saascrm.site/docs/webhooks): Event names, payload shape, and signature verification
- [SaaSCRM MCP server](https://saascrm.site/docs/mcp): How the in-app AI tools map to a Model Context Protocol server
- [llms.txt](https://saascrm.site/llms.txt): Agent index for this site
- [About / schema browser](https://saascrm.site/about): Zod, SQL, Firestore, and Supabase reference snapshots

## Related CRM UI

The template also ships buyer-facing developer screens at https://saascrm.site/api-keys, https://saascrm.site/api-logs, https://saascrm.site/webhooks, and https://saascrm.site/integrations. Those pages are interactive demos, not live credentials.

# SaaSCRM API docs

SaaSCRM ships a frontend-only CRM template. Use this page as the intended REST contract when you connect a backend. The shapes match `schemas/zod-schemas/` and `data.json` in the GitHub repository.

Base URL (when you host the API): `https://{your-domain}/api/v1`

Authentication: send `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` or `X-API-Key: <api_key>`. Create and rotate keys in the SaaSCRM API Keys demo at https://saascrm.site/api-keys, then persist them in your own store.

## Resources

| Resource | Methods | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/leads` | GET, POST | List, search, and create leads |
| `/leads/{id}` | GET, PATCH, DELETE | Lead profile and stage updates |
| `/contacts` | GET, POST | People linked to companies |
| `/contacts/{id}` | GET, PATCH, DELETE | Contact detail |
| `/companies` | GET, POST | Accounts |
| `/deals` | GET, POST | Opportunities with value and owner |
| `/pipelines` | GET | Kanban stages used by deals and leads |
| `/invoices` | GET, POST | Line items and status |
| `/payments` | GET, POST | Payment records linked to invoices |
| `/tasks` | GET, POST | Work items and due dates |
| `/webhooks` | GET, POST | Outbound event subscriptions |

## Example: create a lead

```http
POST /api/v1/leads
Authorization: Bearer $SAASCRM_API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Ada Lovelace",
  "email": "ada@example.com",
  "company": "Analytical Engines",
  "status": "New"
}
```

## Spec and related docs

- Machine-readable spec: https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml
- Auth: https://saascrm.site/docs/auth.md
- Webhooks: https://saascrm.site/docs/webhooks.md
- MCP: https://saascrm.site/docs/mcp.md
- Schema browser in the template: https://saascrm.site/about

# SaaSCRM auth docs

SaaSCRM includes Login, Signup, Forgot password, and Change password screens at https://saascrm.site/login, https://saascrm.site/signup, https://saascrm.site/forgot-password, and https://saascrm.site/change-password. In the demo they validate on the client and toast that you should wire a real auth provider. They do not create hosted sessions on saascrm.site.

## Recommended integration

1. Keep the existing `AuthPageShell` UI from `app/Authentication/`.
2. Replace the toast handlers with your provider (Auth.js, Clerk, Supabase Auth, Firebase Auth, or a custom JWT service).
3. Issue API keys for server-to-server access as documented in the [SaaSCRM API docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/api.md).
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on CRM API calls after the user signs in.

## Roles and teams

The template includes Teams, Users, and Roles screens (https://saascrm.site/teams, https://saascrm.site/users, https://saascrm.site/roles) so you can map IdP groups onto CRM permissions. Audit events belong on https://saascrm.site/audit-log once your backend records them.

## Secrets

Never commit live credentials. `/api-keys` is a UI demo. Store production secrets in your host's environment, not in the Next.js bundle.

---

# SaaSCRM webhooks

SaaSCRM includes a Webhooks developer screen at https://saascrm.site/webhooks. Subscribe demo endpoints to CRM events, then implement the same event names on your backend.

## Events

- `lead.created`, `lead.updated`
- `customer.created`, `customer.updated`, `customer.deleted`
- `order.created`, `order.updated`, `order.cancelled`
- `payment.succeeded`, `payment.failed`
- `invoice.paid`, `invoice.overdue`

## Payload

```json
{
  "id": "evt_123",
  "type": "lead.created",
  "created_at": "2026-08-22T00:00:00.000Z",
  "data": { "id": "lead_1", "email": "ada@example.com" }
}
```

## Verification

Each subscription has a signing secret in the demo UI. On your backend, compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body and compare it to the `X-SaaSCRM-Signature` header. Reject mismatched signatures.

Manage subscriptions in the UI or via `POST /api/v1/webhooks` as described in the [SaaSCRM API docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/api.md) and [OpenAPI spec](https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml).

---

# SaaSCRM MCP server

SaaSCRM does not host a public Model Context Protocol endpoint today. The product's agent interface is the in-app CRM copilot (OpenRouter tool-calling) plus Cursor rules in the open-source repository.

## What to expose as MCP tools

The template's AI layer already describes tools that read and write the in-memory CRM snapshot (leads, deals, invoices, tasks, and related records). When you add a backend, wrap the same operations as MCP tools:

- `list_leads`, `get_lead`, `create_lead`, `update_lead`
- `list_deals`, `update_deal_stage`
- `list_invoices`, `create_invoice`
- `search_crm` across contacts, companies, and activity

## How agents should connect

1. Humans use the SaaSCRM demo chatbot at https://saascrm.site/demo.
2. Coding agents should start at [llms.txt](https://saascrm.site/llms.txt) and the [SaaSCRM API docs](https://saascrm.site/docs/api.md).
3. To run a local MCP server, clone the repo and map those tools onto your API using the OpenAPI spec at https://saascrm.site/openapi.yaml.

A hosted `mcp.saascrm.site` server would require a live backend and credentials — that is a product decision, not part of this frontend template.

---

# SaaSCRM FAQ

Common questions about the SaaSCRM Next.js CRM template.

- **What do I get?** Full React + Next.js source on GitHub, 60+ CRM screens, shadcn/ui, marketing landing, agentic AI chatbot, theme customizer, Zod schemas, and Design.md.
- **Commercial use?** Yes — MIT license for your SaaS or client work.
- **Custom builds?** Yes. Book a call from https://saascrm.site/contact.
- **Do you have an agency CRM?** Yes. Read https://saascrm.site/blog/agency-crm and demo https://saascrm.site/templates/agency.
- **Can I migrate Excel or Google Sheets into a CRM?** Yes. Read https://saascrm.site/blog/excel-to-crm-migration for audit, mapping, and rollout.
- **Where are the CRM guides?** https://saascrm.site/blog — including https://saascrm.site/blog/free-crm-and-top-crm-directory, https://saascrm.site/blog/excel-to-crm-migration, https://saascrm.site/blog/best-crm-for-small-businesses-and-startups, https://saascrm.site/blog/why-your-business-needs-a-crm, and https://saascrm.site/blog/six-crm-templates-you-can-demo-today.
- **Live demo?** https://saascrm.site/demo
- **Stack?** Next.js 12, React 17, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Recharts, Zod.

Full answers: https://saascrm.site/faq
